browser_warning.message: Your browser ({{browser}} {{version}}) is out of date. To ensure the security of your encrypted data, please update your browser to version {{minVersion}} or higher.

api.invalid_request: The request was invalid. Please try again.
api.internal_error: An unexpected server error occurred. Please try again later.
api.unauthorized: Your session is not authenticated. Reload the page to sign in, then retry.
api.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
api.email_claim_required: Your account has no usable email address. An email address is required to use encryption; contact your administrator.
api.forbidden_other_user: You cannot modify another user's public key.
api.rate_limit_keys: You have reached the maximum number of key creations ({{max}}) over the past {{days}} days. This limit protects against abuse. Try again later or contact support.
api.rate_limit_challenges: Too many verification attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
api.no_active_key: No active public key was found for this account.
api.challenge_not_found: The verification request could not be found. Please start again.
api.challenge_expired: The verification request has expired. Please start again.
api.challenge_invalid_response: Proof of possession of your encryption key failed. Please try again.
api.concurrent_registration: Another registration for this account completed at the same time. Please try again.
api.invalid_key_binding: The signature binding your encryption key to your identity is invalid. Please try again.
api.invalid_challenge_signature: Proof of possession of your signature key failed. Please try again.
api.key_version_conflict: Another operation changed your keys at the same time. Please try again.
api.invalid_timestamp: The provided timestamp is too far from the server time. Check your device clock and try again.
api.invalid_public_key: A provided public key is malformed.
api.identity_taken: This identity is already registered to another account.
api.encryption_key_taken: This encryption key is already registered to another account.
api.no_server_vault: These keys were never registered on the server, so they cannot be re-enabled. Remove them from this device and set up encryption again.
api.vault_not_found: No vault exists for this account.
api.vault_challenge_not_found: The unlock request could not be found. Please start again.
api.vault_challenge_expired: The unlock request has expired. Please start again.
api.vault_proof_invalid: The recovery phrase you entered does not open this vault.
api.vault_request_signature_invalid: The request signature is missing or invalid. Please try again.
api.vault_auth_binding_invalid: The vault authentication key is not bound to your identity.
api.vault_kdf_params_invalid: The vault key-derivation parameters are outside the accepted range.
api.vault_manifest_invalid: The vault index is malformed, unsigned, or declares the wrong revision.
api.vault_item_out_of_date: This item was changed elsewhere. Refresh and try again.
api.vault_approval_not_found: The pairing request could not be found or has expired.
api.vault_approval_not_ready: The pairing is still waiting for approval.
api.rate_limit_approvals: Too many pairing requests. Please wait before trying again.

vault.no_keys: No key pair found. Please generate your keys first.
vault.invalid_backup: Invalid backup data. Check your recovery phrase.
vault.wrong_recovery_phrase: That recovery phrase did not unlock your vault. Check the words and try again.
vault.checksum_mismatch: The mnemonic phrase is incorrect (checksum error).
vault.no_vault_to_restore: No vault could be restored with this recovery phrase. Make sure you typed every word correctly and that you are signed in to the right account.
vault.registration_failed: Registering the public key on the central server failed. Please try again.
vault.integrity_failed: Your recovery phrase was correct, but the encryption data returned by the server did not pass its integrity check. It may have been altered. Do not re-enter your phrase, and contact support.
vault.session_expired: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign back in, then retry this action.

onboarding.reset_success: Your previous keys have been disabled (not deleted). You can now set up new ones.
onboarding.explanation: Your encryption keys will be stored on this device and backed up, in encrypted form, so you can restore them on another device with your recovery phrase.
onboarding.explanation_backup_prompt: Right after activation, you will set up your recovery phrase to back up your keys.
onboarding.existing_key_detected: Your account already has a registered encryption key.
onboarding.existing_server_detected: The central server detected an existing encryption configuration for your account. If you still have your backup or another device with your keys, you can restore them below.
onboarding.existing_recovery_hint: If you still have access to your recovery phrase or another connected device, choose one of the options below.
onboarding.btn_start_new_identity: Start over with a new identity
onboarding.title_previous_identity: A previous encryption identity was found
onboarding.previous_identity_detected: Your account already had an encryption identity that is currently disabled. It was likely turned off from another device, or replaced. Its encrypted documents can still be recovered if you have your recovery phrase.
onboarding.previous_identity_hint: Restore it from your backup to bring it back, or start over with a new identity (your old encrypted documents would then stay locked unless you restore later).
onboarding.invalid_word_hint: It looks like one or more words are not in the recovery word list. Check the ones highlighted in red for typos.
onboarding.btn_last_resort: I no longer have access to my keys
onboarding.btn_confirm_reset: Disable old key and start from scratch
onboarding.last_resort_warning: The old public key will be disabled on the central server and a new one generated. Your previous keys are not deleted, but you will not be able to use them without their recovery phrase.
onboarding.last_resort_consequence_1: Documents encrypted with the old key will remain inaccessible until you recover its old recovery phrase (they are not deleted).
onboarding.last_resort_consequence_2: Other members of those documents will need to remove you and re-share access after your new keys are created.
onboarding.last_resort_consequence_3: A new key pair will be generated and you will need to back it up.
onboarding.confirm_fingerprint_to_delete: To confirm, type your current fingerprint below:
onboarding.reactivate_confirm: This recovery phrase belongs to a previous vault (created {{date}}). Reactivating it will disable your current vault, which stays recoverable with its own phrase. Continue?
onboarding.reactivate_cancelled: Reactivation cancelled. Your current vault stays active.
onboarding.extensions_warning: Before continuing, check that the browser extensions you have installed are trustworthy. Extensions have broad access to page content and could potentially access your sensitive data. If in doubt, temporarily disable them.
onboarding.backup_success: Save your recovery phrase now. It will not be shown again. Encryption is only enabled once you confirm below that you have saved it.
onboarding.backup_warning: This recovery phrase is your backup. Without it, you will not be able to restore your encryption keys if this device is cleared or lost, and your encrypted documents would then become permanently inaccessible.
onboarding.backup_option_copy_description: Copy the phrase below and paste it into your password manager (with a physical 2FA key like a security key). This is the safest and most convenient way to restore your keys.
onboarding.backup_option_file_description: Download a text file containing your recovery phrase. Store it in a secure location (encrypted USB drive, external hard drive).
onboarding.backup_option_print_description: Print your recovery phrase and keep it in a safe physical location. Warning: anyone with access to the paper can restore your keys.
onboarding.print_warning: CONFIDENTIAL. Keep this document in a safe place. Anyone with this phrase could eventually access your encrypted documents.
onboarding.reveal_description: You can also reveal the recovery phrase to copy it manually.
onboarding.btn_backup_done: I have backed up my keys

demo.title: Fake Product (Encryption Demo)
demo.subtitle: Demonstrates VaultClient integration. Products use encrypt()/decrypt() via the SDK. Key management goes through encryption.
demo.section_onboarding_note: In production, opens encryption in a visible iframe.
demo.footer: This demo shows two integration layers: product operations via VaultClient (encrypt/decrypt/hasKeys), and privileged operations via encryption (generate/export/import/delete).

settings.title: Encryption settings
settings.no_keys: No encryption keys are configured on this device. Enable encryption from a Suite product to get started.
settings.safety_fingerprint_hint: This is your own identity's safety fingerprint. When someone wants to be sure they are really sharing with you, read these digits to them or show them side by side, so they can confirm they match what they see for you.
settings.remote_disabled_warning: This device's encryption identity is no longer active on the server. It was likely disabled from another device or browser signed in as you. This device still works with its local keys, and your backup can restore it, but other users can no longer share new documents with you until it is re-enabled.
settings.remote_diverged_warning: The encryption identity registered on the server for your account is different from this device's. Another device signed in as you may have changed or replaced it. Until this is resolved, this device and the server disagree about your identity.
settings.remote_never_warning: This device has local encryption keys that were never registered on the server. This usually means an earlier setup did not finish. These keys cannot be re-enabled, because there is no vault behind them: the only safe option is to remove them and set up encryption again from scratch.
settings.remote_never_hint: Removing these keys clears this device's unfinished setup so you can start over cleanly. If you have a recovery kit from a completed setup, you can restore from it afterwards.
settings.reconcile_onboard_fresh: Remove these keys and set up encryption again
settings.reconcile_reenable_hint: Re-enabling re-registers this device's keys on the server so others can share with you again. Nothing on this device changes.
settings.reconcile_diverged_hint: Keeping this device's identity re-registers it as the active one and disables the identity the other device set, which will then need to reconcile in turn. Using the server's identity discards this device's local keys and re-acquires the active one from another device or your recovery phrase.
settings.reconcile_adopt_confirm: This will delete this device's local encryption keys and set it up again from the server's identity. Continue?
settings.change_phrase_success: Save your new recovery phrase now. It will not be shown again. The change only takes effect once you confirm below that you have saved it; until then your current phrase keeps working.
settings.change_phrase_warning: Changing your recovery phrase creates a new one. All existing backups of your current phrase (password manager, file, printout) will stop working. You will need to save the new one before it takes effect.
settings.change_phrase_confirm_saved: I have saved my new recovery phrase
settings.change_phrase_committed: Your recovery phrase has been changed. Your previous phrase and its backups no longer work.
settings.delete_warning_backup: Without a backup and without another device holding these keys, this deletion will be irreversible. You will permanently lose access to your encrypted documents where you are the only member.
settings.confirm_data_loss: I understand that without a backup or another device with the same keys, encrypted documents will become permanently unreadable
settings.also_disable_server: Also disable this public key on the central server, so from now on other users can no longer share documents encrypted for it
settings.disable_server_warning: Only check this option if you no longer wish to use the keys corresponding to this fingerprint. If you plan to restore your keys later from a backup or another device, do not disable the server key.
settings.confirm_server_disable: I understand that disabling the server key will prevent others from sending me encrypted data until I create new keys
settings.confirm_fingerprint_prompt: Enter your key fingerprint above to confirm:

auth.required_explanation: To access your encryption settings, you need to authenticate. A new tab will open for you to sign in securely. Once signed in, the tab will close automatically and you can continue.
auth.authenticating: Authenticating… Please complete the sign-in in the tab that opened.
auth.oidc_not_configured: The encryption interface is not properly configured. OIDC authentication settings (VITE_OIDC_ISSUER, VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID, VITE_OIDC_REDIRECT_URI) are missing. Please contact the administrator.
auth.success: Authentication successful! You can close this tab.
auth.wrong_user: You are signed in with a different account than the one used in the application. Please sign in with the correct account.
auth.no_user_context: The application did not provide user context. The encryption interface cannot work without knowing which user is authenticated. Please make sure you are logged in to the application.

device_approval.new_intro: Show this code to a device that already has your keys, so it can grant this one access.
device_approval.new_code_hint: On your other device, scan this QR code with its camera.
device_approval.new_reveal_code: No camera on the other device? Show a code to type
device_approval.new_manual_hint: Or, if you cannot scan the QR code, type this code on your other device:
device_approval.new_waiting: Waiting for approval from your other device…
device_approval.new_success: This device is now enrolled and its keys are ready.
device_approval.approve_intro: Scan the QR code shown on the new device to grant it access to your keys.
device_approval.scan_hint: Point the camera at the QR code on the new device.
device_approval.manual_intro: Type the code shown on the new device.
device_approval.code_no_match: That code does not match any device waiting to be added. Check the digits and try again.
device_approval.approve_success: Approved. The new device can now finish setting up.
device_approval.invalid_code: That pairing code is not valid.

verify.title: Verify who you are sharing with
verify.explanation: The encryption identity of these recipients has changed, or you refused it before. To protect against impersonation, confirm them before sharing.
verify.compare_instruction: Compare each safety fingerprint below with the one the recipient reads to you out of band (in person, by phone, or over a trusted channel). Only confirm if they match exactly.
verify.refuse_aborts: This share only goes through if you trust each recipient below. Refusing any of them, or cancelling, cancels the whole share.
verify.note_changed: This contact's encryption key changed since you last verified it.
verify.recipients_without_keys: Some recipients have not enabled encryption yet. The encrypted share cannot proceed until they have a key.

profile.title: Encryption Identity
profile.compare_instruction: Ask this contact to read out the fingerprint from their own encryption settings (in any LaSuite product), over a trusted channel. Trust only if it matches exactly.
profile.no_key: This contact hasn't set up encryption yet, so there is nothing to verify.
